scope: Pre-execution conflicts and attempted falsifications found during sample/gold preparation. These are not observed A/P outcomes.
judge: worker / internal separate sampling agent, same model family

cases.type: accepted answer versus initial license/support constraints
cases.confirmed: The initial question prohibits open-source software and requires company support. Pentaho is accepted, but the answer does not identify the edition. A different answer recommends Debezium with commercial support.
cases.attempt_to_disprove: Read the official Pentaho product description and compared license identity with the Apache NiFi control. Commercial support and source licensing are separate properties; no exact Pentaho edition was inferred.
cases.limits: No confirmed finding that the adopted Pentaho edition violates the original condition. Acceptance alone cannot resolve edition/contract scope.
cases.analysis_action: Keep grade 2. Label edition/constraint compatibility unverified; repeat any adoption-versus-constraint conclusion with this ambiguous case separated.
cases.minimum_next_check: Obtain the edition/deployment identity from an existing public clarification, or leave it unresolved without contacting the asker.

cases.type: adoption after preference and goal refinement
cases.confirmed: The accepted self-answer uses Caddy and describes a working configuration despite relaxing minimalism and changing the preferred Alpine environment to Ubuntu.
cases.attempt_to_disprove: Preserved the initial revision rather than updating the question to match adoption. Checked the official Caddy server identity; did not promote its security marketing to a measured result.
cases.limits: Minimalism is not a numeric hard threshold, and Alpine was a preference. Neither change alone proves a hard violation.
cases.analysis_action: Inspect any P rejection for whether it wrongly hardens preferences. Retain the external grade 2 independently.
cases.minimum_next_check: Compare both conditions' candidate explanations against the original ordered requirement list and the accepted self-answer; no new user contact is needed.

cases.confirmed: The asker requested a Python-free single-binary alternative, then explicitly reported replacing Fail2Ban with sshguard and continuing to use it despite multiple installed binaries.
cases.attempt_to_disprove: Distinguished actual installation/use from gratitude or intent. Read the later report of continued satisfaction and the official SSHGuard architecture.
cases.limits: The current HN question is not a recovered initial revision. Package behavior was not executed locally.
cases.analysis_action: Report adopted-answer ranking and initial-condition compliance separately. A constraint-based rejection can be historically wrong while accurately reflecting the written initial request.
cases.minimum_next_check: In the blind output comparison, examine exact binary-count wording and whether the candidate is retained conditionally or rejected outright.

cases.type: adoption after hardware expansion and later model release
cases.confirmed: The 2026-07-02 question requires an 8GB GPU without CPU spill. The asker later bought a 24GB RTX 3090 and reported hosting Qwen3.8-27B Q4. The official README dates Qwen3.8-27B release to 2026-08-14.
cases.attempt_to_disprove: Checked both the original hardware section and the use report, then directly read the official model release chronology. The later configuration was not silently substituted into the initial question.
cases.limits: Exact Q4 quantization artifact and measured memory were not identified. The mismatch does not establish failure of all smaller models or all quantization methods.
cases.analysis_action: Preserve grade 2 while marking changed hardware and post-question availability. Report historical adopted-answer hit both with and without post-question-release targets.
cases.minimum_next_check: Inspect A/P date labels and hardware qualifiers, and recompute adopted-answer metrics excluding this target in the question-date-availability sensitivity.

cases.type: reported limitation does not establish universal official impossibility
cases.confirmed: The asker reports insufficient backend information, while the current official BuiltWith description includes developer-infrastructure and technology coverage beyond a narrow frontend label.
cases.attempt_to_disprove: Searched the official API/site and read its current capability description before using the familiar tool as a negative control.
cases.limits: Marketing breadth does not establish reliable discovery of each requested backend technology; no empirical accuracy check was run.
cases.analysis_action: Keep this control auxiliary_unjudged rather than strict N.
cases.minimum_next_check: A scoped product/version feature test against known backend stacks would be needed to label a precise hard-condition violation.

cases.type: component composition can rescue an apparent location mismatch
cases.confirmed: The question permits triggering commands on a home machine via SSH. A runner executing elsewhere is therefore not automatically incompatible with the requested home-machine execution.
cases.attempt_to_disprove: Read the source question's explicit SSH allowance and the official hosted-runner description instead of equating runner hosting location with every command's execution location.
cases.limits: Connectivity, credentials and firewall feasibility for the asker's network were not tested.
cases.analysis_action: Keep this control auxiliary_unjudged. Judge proposed composition and assumptions rather than product category alone.
cases.minimum_next_check: Review whether each condition explains the SSH path and required connectivity; do not require a live account or deployment for this study.

cases.type: exact-license wording and component role are not settled by labels
cases.confirmed: The official parser produces a Bash AST under MIT. The question asks for a conversion function and AGPL3; an AST adapter could contribute, while exact-license versus compatible-integration intent is unresolved.
cases.attempt_to_disprove: Read the actual output format and license rather than declaring any non-AGPL name incompatible. No legal incompatibility claim was made.
cases.limits: No wrapper was implemented and no legal conclusion is supported.
cases.analysis_action: Keep this control auxiliary_unjudged and retain the external accepted Crash JS function separately.
cases.minimum_next_check: Determine whether the proposed answer includes the conversion adapter and clearly states license scope; otherwise mark unverified.

cases.type: soft modal wording can change strict-negative eligibility
cases.confirmed: The Node proxy depends on the Node/npm ecosystem, while the source question uses should when asking to avoid that ecosystem.
cases.attempt_to_disprove: Preserved the original modal and added a sensitivity analysis that treats this wording as preference instead of hard exclusion.
cases.limits: A strict negative is conditional on the experiment's must interpretation; the official dependency fact alone cannot settle that interpretation.
cases.analysis_action: Report N rejection with N015 included and excluded; do not silently harden wording in output judgments.
cases.minimum_next_check: Use the already recovered revision1 text and blind judge the modal strength independently of A/P condition.
